catalog_etaNormal: Delivered tomorrow morning by Mr. Chai's boat
customer_left: The customer got tired of waiting.
day_ending: Closing soon: finish what you're doing.

prompt.click_mat: Click the work mat to get to work
prompt.decor: Click: place · Del: sell at 50% · X: back to stock
prompt.camera: Wheel: zoom · Right click: rotate · WASD or Shift+drag: move · F: focus

pairing.display: True Tone lives in the original display: read its data with the programmer before swapping.
pairing.home_button: Touch ID is paired to the board: it won't work with a new button.
pairing.front_sensor: The sensor is paired to the board: replacing it loses face unlock.
pairing.battery: Without the programmer the phone will show 'unknown battery'.
pairing.rear_camera: The new camera needs calibrating with the programmer.
